guard: the theme helpers emit ANSI only on a TTY with NO_COLOR unset or empty, and are plain text otherwise
why: Each case imports theme.ts from src in a fresh tsx child, so a mutation is seen without a build and needs no rebuild after the restore.
Each mutation is compile-clean and its anchor occurs exactly once in the named file.

mutations.name: T1 piped output keeps its colour
mutations.expectRed: a non-TTY stdout renders bold as plain text
mutations.cell: a non-TTY stdout renders bold as plain text
mutations.note: Without the TTY half, anything redirected to a file or a pipe carries escape codes.

mutations.name: T2 NO_COLOR is ignored
mutations.expectRed: NO_COLOR=1 on a TTY renders bold as plain text
mutations.cell: NO_COLOR=1 on a TTY renders bold as plain text
mutations.note: On a non-TTY the TTY half already turns colour off, so only the TTY case can see NO_COLOR dropped.

mutations.name: T3 an empty NO_COLOR counts as set
mutations.expectRed: NO_COLOR= on a TTY still colours
mutations.cell: NO_COLOR= on a TTY still colours
mutations.note: no-color.org only counts NO_COLOR when it is present and not an empty string.

mutations.name: T4 the theme never colours
mutations.note: The positive control: without it every plain-text cell passes against a theme that never colours.
